reference: Ɔbɛdii hene no, na wadi mfeɛ aduasa nnum, na ɔdii hene mfirinhyia aduonu nnum wɔ Yerusalem.

reference: Na Konania nso ne ne nuanom Semaia, Netanel, Hasabia, Yeiel ne Yosabad, Lewifoɔ asafohene no yii Twam nnwan mpemnum ne anantwie ahanum maa Lewifoɔ no.
hypothesis: Nkonnwa nnua nson ne ne nuanom si maaya, netaaneɛ, kasabea, yie a ne yɛsa baab. Lɛɛrefoɔ asafoɔ no yɛ twam nnwan, mpam num ne, anantwie ahenom ma lɛɛrefoɔ no.

reference: Na afoforɔ bi nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ atwerɛfoɔ, mpanimfoɔ ne aponoanohwɛfoɔ.
hypothesis: Afoforɔ bi nso yɛ adwuma sɛ atwerɛfoɔ. Mpanimfoɔ ne apona no hyɛfo.

hypothesis: N'ahofiri adeɛ no, yɛhosa fɔt gyina na ɔka asɛe. Yɛudane yɛresolɛmfoɔ.

reference: Afei, me Nyankopɔn, ma w’aniwa mmue ɛ, na yɛ aso ma ɛha yi mpaebɔ.
hypothesis: Afee mmenyin agopon ma wɔn aniwa mmo yɛ na yɛ asoɔma ɛhan mpaeɛ bɔ.

reference: Na adeɛ biara a AWURADE Nyankopɔn agye de ama yɛn sɛ yɛnni soɔ no, ɛno na yɛbɛfa adi soɔ.

reference: Ntotorobɛntohyɛnfoɔ ne nnwomtofoɔ no nyinaa bɔɔ mu too dwom de kamfoo Awurade, daa no ase.

reference: Na Samson frɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: AWURADE Nyankopɔn, afei kae me, na hyɛ me den prɛko pɛ yi nko ara, Onyankopɔn, na mentɔ m’ani mmienu yi so were prɛko Filistifoɔ so.
hypothesis: N'asamsefrɛ rade sɛ ɛrade nyanko pɔn afee kaa mu. Na hyɛm de mprɛko pɛ yi nko ara. Wɔnyɛ akokɔpɔn na mentɔ mɛnum yi nso re prɛko filetifoɔ so.

reference: Ɛnyɛ wo so na mebaa nnɛ, na mmom efie a ɛne me di ako no so na Onyankopɔn aka sɛ menyɛ ntɛm.

reference: Na ne ba Manase bɛdii n’adeɛ.

reference: Ɔduruu ɔbarima no ho no, ɔbisaa no sɛ, “Wo na wokaa biribi kyerɛɛ me yere no anaa?
hypothesis: Oduro a ɔbarima no ho no, ɔbusua no hyɛ. Wɔn a wɔka biribi kyerɛ mmaayiri no anan. Ɔboa hyɛ a ne ɛyɛ me. Ntoma no a ɔbusua no hyɛ hyɛ nsɛm a .

reference: Enti obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ wiase adamfoɔ no gyina hɔ sɛ Nyankopɔn tamfo.
hypothesis: Nti obi a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ wiase adanfoɔ no gyina hɔ sɛ ɔnyɛnko pɔnkɔ.

reference: Na wammrɛ ne ho ase AWURADE anim sɛdeɛ n’agya Manase brɛɛ ne ho aseɛ no, na ɔno Amon maa mfomsoɔ dɔɔso.
hypothesis: Nwamerɛ no ho aseɛ wura adeɛ, ne nsa deɛ ne gyam anaa ase brɛ no ho aseɛ no. na ɔno ama ɔman fom soɔ dɔɔso.

reference: Na asɔfoɔ no antumi anhyɛne AWURADE dan no mu, ɛfiri sɛ na AWURADE animuonyam no ayɛ AWURADE dan no ma.

reference: Ɛne Onyankopɔn a ɔka me ho no nnni asie, na wansɛe wo.

reference: Na Usia tii n’agyanom wɔ asamando, na wɔsiee no n’agyanom nkyɛn ahemfo asieeɛ asase no so, na wɔkaa sɛ: Ɔyaree kwata.

reference: Na Yudafoɔ boaboaa wɔn ano sɛ wɔrebɛhwehwɛ AWURADE hɔ mmoa.

reference: Ano korɔ no ara mu na nkamfo ne nnome firi ba.

hypothesis: Nnipa a wɔtam de ɔhene fie no so. Na ɔbu asase no so ɔman no atɛn.

reference: Na wɔamfiri ɔhene mmara asɛm a ɛda asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no soɔ no ho, nsɛm nyinaa ne akoradeɛ no fam.
hypothesis: Nawɛnfiri ɔhene mmerɛnsa mu a ɛda asɔfoɔ ne lɛɛrefoɔ no soɔ no ho nsa nyinaa ne akoradeɛ ne fam.

reference: Onipa tenenee adesrɛ a emu yɛ den tumi yɛ nnoɔma bebree.
hypothesis: Nnipa tena ne adesradeɛ a ɛmu yɛ adeɛ ntumi yɛ nneɛma bebree.

reference: Na ɔman no nyinaa, Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa mu mpanimfoɔ no, bɛgyinaa Nyankopɔn man dwabɔ no mu, wɔyɛ mmarima mpemahanan a wɔnam anammɔn mu a wɔtwe nkrantɛ.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Lewifoɔ a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ Israel nyinaa nhunumu na wɔyɛ akronkronfoɔ ma AWURADE no sɛ: Momfa adaka kronkron no mmɛsi efie a Israelhene Salomo, Dawid ba, siiɛ no mu.

reference: Na Samson ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wɔde nhomamono nson a ɛnwoeɛ kyekyere me a, ɛnneɛ mɛhodwo, na mayɛ sɛ onipa biara.

reference: Yɛde nnareka to ɔpɔnkɔ anom sɛdeɛ ɔbɛtie yɛn na yɛatumi ama wakɔ baabiara a yɛpɛ sɛ ɔkɔ.

reference: Kerubim yi ntaban a wɔatrɛ mu no yɛ basafa du, na wɔgyinagyina wɔn nan so, na wɔn anim hwɛ ɛdan no.
hypothesis: Caribom yi ntaban a wɔatere mu no yɛ basafado, na wɔgyinagyina wɔn nan so, na wɔn anim hwɛ dan no.

reference: Na ogyaframa no resɔre afiri afɔrebukyia no so akɔ soro no, AWURADE bɔfoɔ no foro faa afɔrebukyia no so gyaframa no mu kɔɔ soro.
hypothesis: N'ahogyaframa no sɔre afiri bukyia no so akɔ soro no. Ademɔfoɔ no foforɔ abukyia no so gyaframa no mu kɔ soro.

reference: Ɔbɔɔ mpaeɛ frɛɛ Awurade, maa ɔsaa no yadeɛ daa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ nwanwasoɔ bi adi kyerɛɛ no.

reference: Nanso wɔdii Nyankopɔn abɔfoɔ no ho fɛw, na wɔbuu ne nsɛm no animtia, na wɔsereseree n’adiyifoɔ no de kɔsii sɛ AWURADE abufuhyeɛ no sɔre tiaa ne man no a wɔannya ano aduro.
hypothesis: Nansuodi nyinaa gu pɔnabɔfoɔ no ho hwɛw. Na wɔbu ne nsam no animhia. Na wɔsensene ne adeefoɔ no de kɔsi sɛ, awuradeɛ abubu hyia no so retia ne mmaa no a wɔanya ano aduro.

reference: Ɛnyɛ wone yɛn Nyankopɔn a wotuu asase yi sofoɔ firii wo man Israel anim na wode maa wo dɔfo Abraham asefoɔ sɛ wɔntena so daa?
hypothesis: Nya wɔ ne yɛnyɛangpon a wotu asase yi so foafuru wɔ ma ɛsraa anim na wɔde ma wɔdɔfo abraha asɛfoɔ sɛ wɔtena so daa.

reference: Ɔyɛɛ abosonsom asɔreeɛ wɔ Yuda nkuro nyinaa so a wɔbɔ afɔdeɛ wɔ hɔ ma anyame foforɔ no.
hypothesis: Ɔyabɔsonson asɔreɛ wɔ wita nkuro nyinaa so a ɔbɔ afadeɛ wɔ hɔ ma ndzɛmba foforɔ no.

reference: Ɛfiri ano kɔsi ano yɛ basafa nnum.
hypothesis: Efra no kosi ano yɛ basafa no mu.

reference: Na ɔman no nyinaa kɔɔ Baal fie kɔdwirii gui, na n’afɔrebukyia ne n’ahoni no, wɔbubui, na Baal sɔfoɔ Matan nso, wɔkumm no afɔrebukyia no anim.
hypothesis: Nnɔmaa no nyinaa kɔ ɔbaa fie kɔ dweregwe. Na n’aforebu kyia ne n’ahɔnni no, ɔbubu oe. Na baasa foɔ ma ata nso wɔ kum no, aforebu kyia no anim.

reference: Huram brɛɛ no ahyɛn a ɔno ankasa mpanimfoɔ hwɛ so, na emu adwumayɛfoɔ yɛ wɔn a wɔnim adwuma yie.
hypothesis: Kura mbrɛ no ahyɛn a na ɔnoa kasan mpanimfoɔ ɛhwɛ so na ɛmu adwumayɛfoɔ yɛ wɔn a wɔn anim adwuma yi yɛ.

reference: Na bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiɛnsa no, ɔgyaa ɔman no kwan maa wɔkɔɔ wɔn afie.
hypothesis: N'abosu ne atɔsonson dɛ atɔso aduonu mmiɛnsa no. Wogyawma ne kɔnma a wɔrekɔ wɔn fie.

reference: Nso asɔfoɔ no mu mpanimfoɔ nyinaa ne ɔman no maa wɔn mmarato dɔɔso pii sɛ wiase amanaman akyiwadeɛ nyinaa, na wɔguu AWURADE fie a wayɛ no kronkron Yerusalem no ho fi.
hypothesis: Nsuo asɔfoɔ no mu mpanimfoɔ nyinaa ne ɔman no ma wɔn mmeratoɔ doɔ so pii sɛ wɔase ama ama akyire wɔ adeɛ nyinaa. Na wɔgu a wɔde fie a wɔayɛ no kurɔn kurɔn yɛlesaw no ho fi.

reference: Na ne ba Hesekia bɛdii n’adeɛ.
hypothesis: Nnipa edzikia bedie na adeɛ.

reference: Na afei monyi mma busufoɔ a wɔwɔ Gibea no mmra na yɛnku wɔn, na yɛnyi bɔne no mfiri Israel.
hypothesis: N'afee, mbanyin abusufoɔ a wɔregye bea nom mbrɛ na yɛn nkoɔ na yɛn bɔ ne nom firi Israel.

reference: Na anigyeɛ kɛseɛ baa Yerusalem; anigyeɛ a ɛfiri Dawid ba Salomo berɛ so ebi mmaa Yerusalem saa da.
hypothesis: Anigyeɛ kɛseɛ baa yareesalam. Anigyeɛ a afiri daa bi dwa sɛne wɔn berɛ so ebi ma yareesalam saa da.

reference: AWURADE Nyankopɔn, nnane deɛ woasra no no ani.
hypothesis: Ewurade nyanko pɔn, nye wɔn ani mfidie wɔ asrani no so.

reference: Nso na mmarima ne mmaa ayɛ efie hɔ ma, na Filistifoɔ asafohene nyinaa nso wɔ hɔ, na mmarima ne mmaa bɛyɛ mpensa wɔ ɛdan no atifi rehwɛ Samson agorɔ no.
hypothesis: Nsona mmarima ne mmaa a wɔfie hɔ ma na free stifoɔ asafoɔ nyinaa nso wɔ hɔ na mmarima ne mmaa bɛyɛ mpɛnsa wɔ dan no atifi hwɛ samsɛn agorɔ no.

reference: Na Israelfoɔ no de ayɛyɛdeɛ nam ne so kɔmaa Moabhene Eglon.
hypothesis: Adafrafoɔ no de ayɛ deɛ nam ne so kɔn mu a mmua apene agorɔ.

reference: Nanso na asɔfoɔ no nnɔɔso nti, wɔn nko ara antumi anyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no nyinaa, enti wɔn nuanom Lewifoɔ no boaa wɔn kɔsii sɛ wɔwiee adwuma no ansa na asɔfoɔ no reyɛ wɔn ho kronkron.
hypothesis: N'asene asɔfoɔ no n'ɔsene ti. Wɔn nko ara ntumi a ɛyɛ ɔhyia afadeɛ no nyinaa. Ntoa nnua no reyɛfoɔ no boa a wɔn kɔsiesie wɔn wi a adwuma no ansa na asɔfoɔ no yɛ wɔn ho kurɔnkuo.

reference: Na Yehosafat nyaa ahodeɛ ne animuonyam bebree.
hypothesis: Na ɛhosafoɔ ato nya ahodoɔ ne ne mmonan bebree.

reference: Nsɛm yi ne nnwuma mu nokorɛdie yi akyiri no, Asiriahene Sanaherib bae, na ɔbaa Yuda so bɛkyeree nkuro a ɛyɛ den no ho nsraban, na ɔsusuu sɛ ɔbɛdwiri afa.

reference: Na ɔno so na Sikri ba Amasia a ɔde ne ho maa AWURADE som kwa no die, na mmarima a wɔtumi wɔn ho mpemahanu ka ne ho.
hypothesis: Ɔno nso na sikri ba amesia a ɔde ne ho ma a awura de som kwa no deɛ. Na mmarima a wɔtumi wɔn ho, mpam ahen no ka ne ho.

reference: Na Salomo wiee AWURADE fie ne ɔhene fie no.
hypothesis: Nasalam a wɔwie awurade fie ne ɔhene fie no.

reference: Wɔfirii Efraim a wɔn nhini muni dii Amalek soɔ.
hypothesis: Wɔfirafira ma wɔn hwene munediyi ammalexuo.

reference: Afei, nso, nneɛma a ɔhene Ahas tasee wɔ ɛberɛ a na ɔyɛ asoɔden, na ɔtoo asɔredan no mu no nso, yɛakɔgye ne nyinaa.
hypothesis: Afee nso, nneɛma a ɔhene ɛha stase wɔ ɛbrɛ a n'ana ɔyɛ asoɔden na ɔto asoɔ dan ne mu nso no. yɛkɔgye ne nyinaa.

reference: Wɔn nyinaa ani gyeeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ, na Awurade ne Dawid, Salomo ne nkurɔfoɔ Israelfoɔ adi no yie.
hypothesis: Wɔn nyinaa anigyeɛ fi sɛ na ɛrwadɛ ne dewie. Salom ne nkurɔfoɔ adwrafoɔ no di no yie.

reference: Na ɔde sika kataa ɛdan no mpuna, aponnwa, n’afasuo ne n’apono ntanta no ho.
hypothesis: Odze sika kata ɛdan ne mpuna, aponwa na fasuo ne apono ntaataa no ho.

reference: Enti, anuanom, monya abodwokyɛre nkɔduru da a Awurade bɛba.
hypothesis: Nti anuanom, mbonyin abɔ dwukyere, nkodoɔ da awura ade bɛba.

reference: Nnipa a wɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ mo mfuo mu no, montuaa wɔn ka enti wɔresi apinie.
hypothesis: Nnipa wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ wɔn mframon no. Wɔntua wɔn nka. Nti wɔresi apeni.

reference: Ne berɛ so na Edom tee atua firii Yuda nsa aseɛ, na wɔkɔsii wɔn so hene.
hypothesis: Nnipa nso na ɛdɔm te adua afiri yi da nsa aseɛ. Na ɔkɔsi wɔn so hene.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Gyina ntomadan no pono ano, na sɛ obi ba na ɔbisa wo sɛ obi wɔ hɔ anaa a, woaka akyerɛ no sɛ: Dabi.
hypothesis: Nnɔka kyerɛ no sɛ gyina ntomadan no pono ano, na sɛ obi ba no a obi sa a ɔsɛ obi wɔ hɔ anaa, waka akyerɛ no sɛ dɛɛbi.

reference: Anuanom, monngugu ahome nntiatia mo ho, na wɔammu mo atɛn.
hypothesis: Anuanom, mmo ngugu ahome ntiatia mu ho, na wɔamu mu atɛn.

reference: Na Yefta hyɛɛ AWURADE bɔ sɛ: Sɛ wode Amonfoɔ no hyɛ me nsa a, ɛnneɛ deɛ ɛbɛfiri me fie apono ano abɛhyia me da a meresane mafiri Amonfoɔ so dwoodwoo no, ɛbɛyɛ AWURADE deɛ, na mede bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ mu.
hypothesis: N'ayɛfita hyɛ ɛrwadɛ bɔ sɛɛ. Saa ɔdea amamfoɔ no hyɛ mmiɛnsa a ɛna yɛde abɛfiri mfiaa pono ano abesia me da mmiɛnsa mmafiri a amamfoɔ no so yɛɛyɛɛ no. Ɛbɛyɛ ɛrwadi deɛ. Na mmɛde bɛbɔ afɔdeɛ mu.

reference: Ɛberɛ biara a Israelfoɔ bɛkɔ ɔko no, Awurade ko tia wɔn ma wɔdi nkoguo, sɛdeɛ ɔhyɛɛ bɔ no.
hypothesis: Mmusuakuo no mu biara kɔ forɔ a ne gyapadeɛ a wɔde mma ano no sɛ ne kyɛ fa no. Na adwrafoɔ no so, ɛrade wɔ yɛwisoɔ ne mpanimfoɔ a wɔanyin no si no yɛwisoɔ a wɔhunu nneɛma akɛseɛ a ɛrade yɛma adwira yɛwisoɔ nkwan no nyinaa mu no.

reference: Na Manoa ka kyerɛɛ ne yere sɛ: Wuo na yɛrebɛwuwuo, sɛ yɛahunu Onyankopɔn yi.
hypothesis: Nnamano a wɔaka kyerɛ ne yerɛsɛɛ. Wɔn a wɔbɛwuwuo sei ahunu anya nkɔpɔn yi.

reference: Aboɔdemmoɔ a ɛyɛ fɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ a ɛfiri Parwaim na wɔde siesiee Asɔredan no afasuo ho.
hypothesis: Abɔdeɛmoo a ɛyɛ fɛ, nisaka kɔkɔɔ a ɛfiri paawa mu, na wɔde siesie asɔre dan no afasuo ho.

reference: Ahonhommɔne nso gye di saa ara na wɔn ho popo wɔ suro mu.
hypothesis: Ahobɔ no nso gyedi saa ara, na wɔn ho pɔpɔ wɔ soro mu.

reference: Na Israelfoɔ no nso firii hɔ berɛ no mu kɔɔ wɔn mmusuakuo ne wɔn mmusua mu, na wɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ wɔn agyapadeɛ ho.
hypothesis: Akwantufoɔ bi wɔ adeɛ. Na wɔn nyinaa gyina hɔ. Na wɔn nyinaa gyina hɔ. Na wɔn nyinaa gyina hɔ. Na wɔn nyinaa gyina hɔ. Na wɔn nyinaa gyina hɔ. Na wɔn nyinaa gyina hɔ.

reference: Ɔwɔ akuafoɔ ne bobeturoyɛfoɔ, mmepɔ so ne Karmel so, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔpɛ kua.
hypothesis: Ɔwɔ akuafoɔ ne bobɔturo yɛfoɔ me pɔ so ne kraman so efirisɛn na ɔpekuafoɔ.

reference: Ɛnyɛ ɔko a ɔne Filistifoɔ koeɛ no mu nko ara na Onyankopɔn boaa no, na mmom ɔko a ɔne Arabfoɔ a wɔwɔ Gur Baal koeɛ ne Meunifoɔ ko mu nso, ɔboaa no.
hypothesis: Ɛnyɛ ɔko a nafolisifoɔ kɔ yɛ ne mua no na ɔnyɛ akɔpɔ mpoano. Ne mu ɔko a ɔnearafoɔ a wɔwɔ gu baako yɛ ne mpanimfoɔ kɔ mu nso, ɔboa no.

reference: Afei, da bi anadwo, Awurade yii ne ho adi kyerɛɛ Salomo, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ.
hypothesis: Afee, dɛbea na adwo. Wɔde yi ne ho a yɛde kyerɛ salom na ɔka kyerɛ no sɛ .

reference: Ɔworɔɔ nʼahentadeɛ no guu nkyɛn baabi sɛdeɛ atamfoɔ no renhunu no.
hypothesis: Ɔwɔ na ntadeɛ no gu nkyɛn baabi sɛde atamfoɔ no ihu no.

reference: Israelfoɔ no bisaa deɛ ɛyɛeɛ a saa awudisɛm yi siiɛ.
hypothesis: Adwadifoɔ no besiadeɛ ɛyɛeɛ a saa ɛwɔ disa mu si.

reference: Na kerub baako no nso ataban yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, na ɛka ɛdan no fasuo no, na ataban baako no nso yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, na ɛpem kerub baako no ataban no.
hypothesis: Nakaar baako no nso ata bae yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa. Na ɛka adan no fasuo no, na ata bae baako no nso yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa. Na pim kaa baako no ata bae no.

reference: Na Amasia firii Edomfoɔ kum sane baeɛ no, ɔde Seirfoɔ anyame bae, na ɔde bɛsisii hɔ fae sɛ anyame, na ɔkotoo wɔn anim, na ɔhyee aduhwam maa wɔn.
hypothesis: Maame esia firi dɔm foɔ kum san bae no. Ɔde sɛfoɔ ɛnyɛma baa yi. Na ɔde bɛsisi hɔ fae sɛ ɛnyɛma. Na ɔkɔtɔ wɔn anim na ɔhyɛ aduhuamma wɔn.

reference: Na ɔman no nyinaa sɔre gyinaa sɛ ɔbarima baako kaa sɛ: Yɛn mu biara renkɔ ntomadan mu, na yɛn mu biara remmane ne fie.
hypothesis: Ɔbaama baako ka aseɛ. Wiemua akɔ ntomadan mu. Na wɔn mu biara mmaa no nifa.

reference: Na Hesekia kaa sɛ wɔmmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ afɔrebukyia no so.
hypothesis: Mahadzaki a wɔaka asɛe wɔn a wɔahyia afadeɛ afadeɛ bukyia no so.

reference: Na sɛ mowɔ nitanmmɔne ne mansotwe mo akoma mu a, ɛnneɛ monnhoahoa mo ho, na monnni atorɔ nntia nokorɛ.
hypothesis: Nasamu wɔ ne tamon ne ne mma nsotwe mu wɔ akoma mu a ɛne ɛmu hoa hoa wɔn ho. Na muni atorɔ ntia no kora.

reference: ” Ɛberɛ a ɔhene Eglon sɔre firii nʼakonnwa mu ara pɛ, Ehud de ne nsa benkum twee sekan a ɔde ahyɛ ne srɛ nifa ho no de wɔɔ ɔhene no yafunu mu.
hypothesis: Bra a ɔhene egu longsɔre firi na akonnwa mu wɔrapɛ. Ewur de ne nsa benkum twere sekan a ɔde hyɛ ne srani fa no so no de wɔ ɔhene no yɛ funum.

reference: Na Sikri, Efraim dɔmmarima bi, kumm ɔhene ba Maaseia ne ahemfie bapɔmma Asrikam ne Elkana a ɔdi ɔhene akyire.
hypothesis: Nasikri afirim dɔm barima bi kum ɔheneba ma aseɛ ne ahemfo bapɔma asri kam ne ɛkaanaa a ɔdi ɔhene akyire.

reference: Mekaa sɛ, Meremmu mʼapam a me ne mo ayɛ no so.
hypothesis: Nnipa asɛ mmarima mu apam a mmɛnimu ayɛ no so.

reference: Na Yehoiada waree yerenom baanu maa no, na ɔwoo mmammarima ne mmammaa.
hypothesis: Yɛho adaware renom baanu ma ano. Na ɔwɔ mmarima rema ne mmarima.

reference: Ɛsɛ sɛ nnipa a aka no di Awurade mmara so, na wɔtenatena afikyire.
hypothesis: Ɛdɛsɛ nnipa a aka no di ɛradɛ mmerɛ aso na wɔtenatena afikyere.

reference: ’ Afei, Ao Awurade, Israel Onyankopɔn, di saa bɔ a woahyɛ wo ɔsomfoɔ Dawid no so.
hypothesis: Afee a ɔde redi aduane akɔpɔn. Disaabɔ a wɔahyɛ wɔn nsɛmfua dewie no so.

reference: Wɔn a wɔfiri Kohat abusua mu no ne: Amasai babarima Mahat ne Asaria babarima Yoɛl.
hypothesis: Wɔn a wɔfiri ko-hat, abusuam ne amasa, ɛba abɛne ma ama hat ne aseɛ a wɔɔba abɛne ma ayiwa.

reference: Na Israelfoɔ no de ayɛyɛdeɛ nam ne so kɔmaa Moabhene Eglon.
hypothesis: Adafrafoɔ no de ayɛ deɛ nam ne so kɔn mu a mmua apene agorɔ.

reference: Ɔsɔfoɔ no kaa sɛ, “Monkɔ no asomdwoeɛ mu, ɛfiri sɛ, Awurade bɛdi mo anim wɔ mo akwantuo no mu.
hypothesis: Ɔsɔfoɔ no kɛtɛɛ, mbɔnkɔ na asomdua mu efisɛɛ. Wɔn adeɛ bɛdi mu anim wɔ wɔn akwantuo no mu. Mmarima baanum no, kɔkuro bi a wɔfrɛ no line si mu.

reference: Na ahyɛn no bobɔe, na wɔantumi ankɔ Tarsis.
hypothesis: Ahyɛn no bɔ boɔ na wɔntumi a nkwataa ases.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wode me tirinwi mpɛsɛmpɛsɛ nson de fra ntomaban nwono a.
hypothesis: Nnipa a ɔka kyerɛ no sɛ, sɛ ɔde ne tiri nnipa mpɛsɛmpɛsɛnso de fra ntomaban nwona.

reference: Ɛberɛ a saa akofoɔ yi duruu Efraim bepɔ asase so no, wɔkɔɔ Mika fie kɔdaa hɔ anadwo no.
hypothesis: Ɛbrɛ a saa akuffo yi duru efira bepɔ asaase ne so. Wɔkɔ mmirika fie kɔda hɔ an adwene.

reference: Na ɔtotoo aban atentene nso ɛserɛ so, na ɔtutuu mmura pii, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔwɔ mmoakuo bebree mpaperɛ ne asaseta so.
hypothesis: Nnwonto abantenten nso serɛ so. Na wɔatu mmerɛ pii, efirisie no a wɔwɔ akuo bebree, mpaprɛ ne asaase tɛ so.

reference: Nanso, ɛrekɔ nʼasetena awieeɛ no, ɔhene Yehosafat ne Israelhene Ahasia a ne tirim yɛ den no kaa wɔn ho bɔɔ mu.
hypothesis: N'aso rekɔ n'asesena wie no. ɔhene yɛosofoɔ ne idra ahwene a ha aseɛ anaa ne tiri nnwadeɛ no ka wɔn ho bɔɔmo.

reference: Afei, Ehud totoo apono no mu foroo agyanan dan no, faa ne nsuseneeɛ no mu dwane kɔeɛ.
hypothesis: Trafi awututu apono no mu foro agyan adan no. Fa no nsuo sini no mu dwa no kɔɔ.

reference: Na mfeɛ bi akyiri no, ɔsiane kɔɔ Ahab nkyɛn Samaria, na Ahab kunkumm nnwan ne anantwie bebree maa no ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔka ne ho no.
hypothesis: Namfie bi akyire no, ɔsan kɔ aha abɔ nkyɛn samarie. Ahab konku mu nnwan nea nantwie bebree ma ano ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔka ne ho no.

reference: Na Manoa sɔre dii ne yere no akyi na ɔbaa ɔbarima no nkyɛn, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Wone ɔbarima a wo ne ɔbaa no kasaeɛ no?
hypothesis: Nnamano asɔ edi ne yere no ekyi. Na ɔbaa barima no nkyɛn. Na ɔka kyerɛ no sɛ, ɔne ɔbarima a ɔne ɔbaa no kasa ɛ no.

reference: Ɛnna wɔkumm Twam Dwan no bosome a ɛtɔ so mmienu no da a ɛtɔ so dunan no.
hypothesis: Ɛna wɔkum twam dwa no, osomia ɛtɔsɔ mmienu de ɛtɔsɔ du nnan no.

reference: Baabi a ɔsii abosonsom asɔreeɛ, sisii Asera afɔrebukyia ne ahoni ansa na ɔrenu ne ho no nso ka ho.
hypothesis: Baabi a ɔsi abosonan asɔreɛ sisi asraafoɔ rebukyia ne ahwene. Ansa na ɔwɔ no ne ho no nso ka ho.

reference: Amanaman yi a m’agyanom asɛe wɔn pasapasa no anyame nyinaa mu hwan na watumi agye ne man me nsam, na mo nyame na ɔbɛtumi agye mo me nsam?
hypothesis: Amaama yi a magya no asɛe wɔ mpasapasa no anyama nyinaa mu hɔn ena. Wɔatumi agye ne mmaa yi mbesam. Na mbonyiname na obotumi agye mu mbesam.

reference: Na yeinom kɔhyɛnee Mika fie kɔfaa ohoni a wɔasene, asɔfotadeɛ ne abusua ahoni ne agudeɛ no no, ɔsɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na moreyɛ yi?
hypothesis: Ayae no kɔhyɛ ne mmika fie kɔfa a ohonin a wɔasene. Asɔfo ntaadeɛ ne abusua ho na ɛni agudie no no. Ɔsɔfoɔ no kakyerɛ wɔn sɛ ɛdan no amu yie.

reference: AWURADE temmufoɔ no ɔmmu Israelfoɔ ne Amonfoɔ ntam atɛn nnɛ.

reference: Na yɛn deɛ, yɛrentumi mfa yɛn mma mu biara mma wɔn aware, ɛfiri sɛ Israelfoɔ akeka ntam sɛ: Nnome nka deɛ ɔde ɔbaa bi bɛma Benyamin awareɛ.

reference: Afei ɛwɔ m’akoma mu, sɛ me ne AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn bɛpam, na n’abufuhyeɛ no afiri yɛn so akɔ.

reference: Na Hanani ba Yehu, ɔdehunufoɔ no, firi kɔhyiaa no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ Ɔhene Yehosafat sɛ: Ɔbɔnefoɔ na ɛsɛ sɛ woboa no, na wɔn a wɔtane AWURADE no na wodɔ wɔn?

reference: Na wɔtii Midian na wɔde Oreb ne Seeb tiri firi Yordan agya brɛɛ Gideon.

reference: Na Awurade buaa sɛ, “Monkɔ na mo ne wɔn nkɔko.

reference: Enti wɔfrɛɛ hɔ sɛ: Bokim, na wɔbɔɔ AWURADE afɔdeɛ wɔ hɔ.

reference: Na ɔnyane firii ne nna no mu, na ɔtuu deɛ wanwono no mu akoroteaa no ne anwonneɛ no.

reference: Na Filistifoɔ no kyeree no tutuu n’ani, na wɔde no kɔɔ Gasa, na wɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn guu no, na ɔyam ayuo apokyerɛfoɔ fie.

reference: Na ne mmapɔmma nso yiyi maa ɔman no, asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no ayamyi so.

reference: Akyire yi, Lewifoɔ yɛɛ wɔn ne asɔfoɔ no aduane, ɛfiri sɛ, na asɔfoɔ no ayɛ adwuma firi anɔpa kɔsi anadwo a wɔrebɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no na wɔrehye sradeɛ no.

reference: Na Nyankopɔn nipa no se: Ɛwɔ AWURADE nsam sɛ ɔbɛma wo adeɛ pii asene yei.

reference: Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ ba bɛtenaa dupɔn a ɛwɔ Ofra a ɛyɛ Abi-eserni Yoas deɛ no ase; na ne ba Gideon repore ayuo nsa-kyi-amena mu, sɛ ɔde rehunta Midianfoɔ.
hypothesis: Narurade bɔfoɔ bɛtena adupon a ɛwɔ wofura ɛyɛ abi ɛsan ne yɔs deɛ no ase na ne baage do ɛpɔre ɛyɔ nsa kyim ne mu sɛɛdi mfuta mediafoɔ.

reference: Ɛno na Libna nso tee atua berɛ no ara mu firii n’aseɛ, ɛfiri sɛ wagya AWURADE, n’agyanom Nyankopɔn no.
hypothesis: Ɛna na alie binom nso te atua berɛ no ara mu afiri n'aseɛ, afiri sɛ wagya awurade ne gyanomnyɛn a nkɔpɔɔ no.

reference: Na ɔno ara deɛ, ɔdanee ne ho firii ahoni a ɛwɔ Gilgal no ho bɛkaa sɛ: Ɔhene, mewɔ ahuntasɛm bi meka mekyerɛ wo.
hypothesis: Naa ɔnoa adeɛ, ɔdan a ɛne nwofiri ahwɔni a ɛwɔ geegar no ho bɛka asɛɛ. Ɔhene, wɔn wɔn ntasɛm bi me kama kyerɛw.

reference: Na AWURADE danee n’ani kyerɛɛ no na ɔkaa sɛ: Fa w’ahoɔden yi ara kɔ kɔgye Israel Midian nsam; ɛnyɛ soma na masoma woɔ yi?
hypothesis: Narade dan ne n'ani kyerɛ no, na ɔka asɛe, foaho a ɔde yie akɔgye Israel media nsam. Anya soma ne m'asom a ɔreyi.

reference: Na Salomo wiee ne mpaebɔ no, ogya firi soro ba bɛhyee ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne okum afɔdeɛ no, na AWURADE animuonyam bɛyɛɛ asɔredan no ma.

reference: Na Salomo wiee AWURADE fie ne ɔhene fie no.
hypothesis: Nasalam a wɔwie awurade fie ne ɔhene fie no.

reference: Saa ara na tɛkrɛma teɛ: ne ketewa yi nyinaa akyi, ɛtumi hoahoa nneɛma akɛseɛ.

reference: Monnye AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn nni, na mobɛtim, na monnye n’adiyifoɔ no nni, na mobɛdi yie.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Afei sɛ manya w’anim animuonyam a, ɛnneɛ yɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi kyerɛ me, sɛ ɛyɛ wo na wo ne me rekasa yi.
hypothesis: Nnɔka kyerɛ no sɛ, afei, sɛmanyɛ wɔn anim anim wɔn nyeɛma a ɛne nsɛnkyɛn no bi kyerɛ me. Saa yɛwɔ na mmenowɔ kasa yi.

reference: Na wɔsiesiee AWURADE som nyinaa da no, na wɔdii Twam no bobɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ AWURADE afɔrebukyia no so, sɛdeɛ Ɔhene Yosia hyɛeɛ no.

reference: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Dabi, na kyekyerɛ nko na yɛrebɛkyekyere woɔ de wo akɔhyɛ wɔn nsa.
hypothesis: N'aka kyerɛ no sɛɛ dɛɛ bi. Na tsetseere nko na yɛbɛ tsetseere a wɔde wɔn akɔhyɛ wɔn nsa.

reference: Ɛnna Israel somaa abɔfoɔ maa wɔkɔɔ Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔyɛ Hesbon hene no nkyɛn, na Israel ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ma yɛntwam w’asase so nkɔ m’afa.

reference: Wɔwiee nsiesie no, wɔde sika no nkaeɛ brɛɛ ɔhene no ne Yehoiada.

reference: Na ɔnantee n’agya Asa kwan so, na wammane amfiri so, na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so.

reference: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ m’agya Dawid sɛ: Ɛsiane sɛ na ɛwɔ w’akomam sɛ anka wobɛsi dan ama me din nti, woyɛɛ no yie sɛ na ɛwɔ w’akoma mu.

reference: Na wɔkaa sɛ: Hwɛ, wɔhyɛ AWURADE fa afe daa Silo a ɛwɔ Betel atifi fam, tempɔn a ɛfiri Betel kɔ Sekem no apueeɛ fam ne Lebona anafoɔ fam.

reference: ” Na sɛ woansɛe awadeɛ na wodi awu a, woabu mmara so.
hypothesis: N'asawasɛe awadeɛ na wɔadie wua wɔbu mbra no so.

reference: Mokɔ a, mobɛto ɔman a wɔte hɔ dwoodwoo; asase no so, na Onyankopɔn de ahyɛ mo nsa; baabi a asase so adeɛ biara nyɛ na hɔ.

reference: Na ɔwɔ mmammarima aduasa a na wɔtenatena mfunumu mma aduasa soɔ na wɔwɔ nkuro aduasa a wɔfrɛ no Yair nkuro de bɛsi nnɛ.

reference: Na Atalia, ɔbɔnefoɔ no mma ahyɛne Nyankopɔn fie no mu, na AWURADE fie akronkronneɛ nyinaa nso, wɔahwere ama Baalim.

reference: Na yɛnni ɔsɔfo panin a ɔnnim yɛn mmerɛyɛ na ɔnni tema mma yɛn, na mmom deɛ wɔasɔ no ahwɛ adeɛ nyinaa mu sɛ yɛn ara, nso wannyɛ bɔne.

reference: Enti obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ wiase adamfoɔ no gyina hɔ sɛ Nyankopɔn tamfo.

reference: Wɔwɔ Mika fie ho no, wɔtee aberanteɛ Lewini no nne, na wɔmanee hɔ, na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwan na ɔde wo baa ha?
hypothesis: Wɔn mmirika fie ho no, wɔte aberanteɛ lirii no ani, na wɔn ani hɔ, na wɔkɔ kakyerɛw nso ɛɛ  hɔn ena wɔde wɔn ba ha.

reference: Na ɔkyɛɛ mmarima ahasa no mu akuo mmiɛnsa, na ɔde ntotorobɛnto hyehyɛɛ wɔn nyinaa nsa ne nkuruwa hunu ne tɛnee a ɛhyehyɛ nkuruwa no mu.

reference: Na Arabfoɔ afomfafoɔ akuo akunkum mmammarima mpanimfoɔ no nyinaa.

reference: Na wɔde nnafua nwɔtwe bio dwiraa Awurade Asɔredan no ankasa.

reference: Sɛ wɔsɔ obi hwɛ a, mma no nnka sɛ: Onyankopɔn na ɔsɔ me hwɛ.

reference: Wo bo bɛfu wɔn ama wɔn atamfoɔ adi wɔn so, afa wɔn nkoa de wɔn akɔ ananasase so, sɛ ɛwɔ akyiri anaa ɛbɛn.
hypothesis: Obubɔfoɔ wɔn ama wɔn atamfoɔ adi wɔn so afa wɔn kɔdeɛ wɔn akɔ anan asase so sɛ wɔn akyire anaa ɛbɛn.

reference: Enti deɛ ɔnim papayɛ na ɔnyɛ no, ɛyɛ bɔne ma no.

reference: Nanso Yosia annane n’ani amfiri ne ho, na mmom ɔsakyeraa ne ho sɛ ɔne no rekɔko, na wantie Neko nsɛm a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn anomu no.

reference: Na Israelfoɔ no kaa sɛ: Monka nkyerɛ yɛn, ɛyɛɛ dɛn na wɔyɛɛ bɔne a ɛte seyie?
hypothesis: Aesraafoɔ no kaa sɛ, munka nkyerɛ yɛ. Ɛyɛ dan na wɔyɛ abɔ nea ɛte fɛ yie.

reference: Na Lewifoɔ no ntwa ɔhene ho nhyia, wɔn akodeɛ nkurakura wɔn nsam.

reference: Saa kwadwom yi abɛyɛ amanneɛ a wɔatwerɛ ahyɛ Kwadwom Nwoma mu.

hypothesis: Akane no na de bɛɛdi ne kriyat sefa.

reference: Na ɔsomaa abɔfoɔ maa wɔkɔɔ Manase nyinaa na wɔn nso hyia bɛdii n’akyi.
hypothesis: N'ahosuwa a abɔfoɔ mmaa ɔrekɔ ɔmanaa sɛ nyinaa na wɔn nso hyia ba di n'akyi.

reference: Na ɔsɔree anadwo na ɔkɔkum Edomfoɔ a wɔatwa ne ho ahyia ne nteaseɛnam so asafohene no.
hypothesis: Na ɔsɔre anadwer na kukum ɛdɔmfoɔ a wɔatwa ne ho ahyia ne nteaseɛ nam so asafoɔ hɛn no.

reference: Nso na Benyaminfoɔ no nnim sɛ amaneɛ rebɛto wɔn.
hypothesis: Nsonabɛyɛ mbenyinfoɔ no nim sɛ amanneɛ bɛtɔn.

reference: Ɔdii ahyɛdeɛ a Awurade nam Gad, a ɔyɛ ɔhene nhunumuni ne odiyifoɔ Natan so de maa Dawid no so.
hypothesis: Odi ahyɛde a ɛrade nam gut a ɔyɛ ɔhene ehunu mu ni ne odiifoɔ no ɛtena asɔde mu adeɛ ɛredi no so.

reference: Na Yosia yiyii akyiwadeɛ no nyinaa firii nsase a ɛyɛ Israelfoɔ deɛ no nyinaa so, na ɔde wɔn a wɔwɔ Israel no nyinaa hyɛɛ ɔsom no mu maa wɔsom AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn.
hypothesis: Ayaresia yi akyi wɔ adeɛ nyinaa firi asase a ɛyɛ Israel adeɛ nyinaa so. Na deɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ Israel no nyinaa hyɛ ɔsono no mu ma wɔsom ɛwura deɛ wɔn anya wɔpɔnk.

reference: Na sɛ mohwɛ nnipa anim de gye wɔn a, modi ho fɔ na Mmara no tia mo sɛ mmaratofoɔ.
hypothesis: Nasamu hwɛ nnipa anim de gye wɔn a wɔde ho afɔ, na mmerano te ama sɛ mmeratofoɔ.

reference: Na ɔyii ananafoɔ anyame ne ahoni no firii AWURADE fie ne afɔrebukyia a ɔsisii no AWURADE fie bepɔ soɔ ne Yerusalem no nyinaa, na ɔkɔtoto guu kuro no akyi.
hypothesis: Nnwoyi ananafoɔ anya mmeni a honin no firi awurade fie ne afɔde bukyia a osisi ne awurade fie bepɔ soɔ no, ɛresan ne nyinaa. Na ɔkɔtotɔ gu kurow no akyi.

reference: Nso Odiyifoɔbaa Debora a ɔyɛ Lapidot yere na na ɔbu Israel atɛn saa berɛ no.
hypothesis: Nsuodifoɔ baage bɔ lɔɔre lapis dɔtire na ɛno obi dza ɛten saa brɛ no.

reference: Na hwɛ, obiara amfiri Yabes-gilead amma badwa no mu, nsraban no mu.
hypothesis: N'ahyɛ, obiaa mfir yɛbɛd gilead a wɔabɛdwa no mu, nsraaban no mu.

reference: Nanso, wansɛ nʼagya Manase, ɛfiri sɛ, wammrɛ ne ho ase amma Awurade.
hypothesis: N'aso wɔn se ne gya ma no ase afi hwɛ. Wɔn mberɛ ne ho ase ama ɛradi.

reference: Na Samson kaa sɛ: Ma me ne Filistifoɔ no nwuwu!
hypothesis: Asramsɛn kaa sɛ maame no afristifoɔ no mu.

reference: Ɛnneɛ na homedadie da so ara wɔ hɔ ma Nyankopɔn man.
hypothesis: Nyeɛma ahome dadeɛ da soa wɔ hɔ ma ɔyɛ akɔpɔnman.

reference: Na sɛdeɛ nipadua a honhom nni mu awuo no, saa ara nso na gyidie a nnwuma nni mu awuo.
hypothesis: Na sɛdeɛ nnipadua ahohoho ne mu awuo no, saa nso na gyee di a nneema ne mu awuo.

reference: Nanso, ɔbaa no anni no nokorɛ enti ɔsane kɔɔ nʼagya fie wɔ Betlehem.
hypothesis: Nanso ɔbaa no enyi ne ne kura nti, ɔsan kor n'egye afie wɔ batlehem.

reference: Gilead te Yordan agya; na Dan deɛ, adɛn nti na ɔne ahyɛn teɛ?
hypothesis: Dwile a te yɔda ne gya, na dan de ade ntina ɔne ahyɛn tie.

reference: Hwɛ, wobɛto wo kɔn awu, na wɔasie wo wɔ da mu asomdwoeɛ mu, na adebɔne a mede mereba ha yi ne ɛhafoɔ soɔ no nyinaa deɛ w’ani renhunu.
hypothesis: Hyɛwobɔtow kwan wɔ mu na osie wɔ dan mu asomdwa mu. Na ade bɔ nea mmɛdde ne ba ha yi ne yɛ haafoɔ yi soɔ no nyinaa adeɛ. Wɔn ani ho.

reference: Yehoiakim dii adeɛ no, na wadi mfirinhyia aduonu enum, na ɔdii ɔhene Yerusalem mfirinhyia dubaako.
hypothesis: Yihoa kɛmdii adeɛ anonua di mfinimhyia aduanu enum. Na ɔdi ɔhene yi resale mfinimhyia baako.

reference: Na saa Melkisedek yi, Salem hene, Ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn sɔfoɔ, Abraham kɔkumm ahene no na ɔresane aba no, ɔkɔhyiaa no hyiraa no.
hypothesis: Nasaa mmaa akyi sɛ dɔteɛ. Saa dɛm hene. Ɔsoro nsoro nyanko pɔnkɔ sofoɔ. Abraha nkokum ahene no na ɔresan aba no. ɔkosua no hyira no.

reference: Ɛberɛ a Yehu rebu atɛn atia Ahab fie no, ɔhyiaa Yuda mpanimfoɔ ne Ahasia abusuafoɔ bi a na wɔresom Ahasia.
hypothesis: Ɛbrɛ a yɛhuru bebu atɛn atua ɛha fie no. Wɔhyia yi da mpanimfoɔ ne ahaseɛ abusua foɔ bi a na wɔsom ahaseɛ.

reference: Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Asaria dii n’akyi, na AWURADE asɔfoɔ aduɔwɔtwe, nnipa a wɔtumi wɔn ho ka ne ho.
hypothesis: Nosofoɔ asɛe reyɛ deɛ n'akyi. Ne rɔdeɛ asofoɔ adiɛ wɔ wɔtwe. Nnipa a wɔtumi wɔn ho ka ne ho.

reference: Yuda ne Yerusalem, monnsuro na mo akoma nntu, ɔkyena momfiri adi nkɔhyia wɔn, na AWURADE bɛdi mo akyi.
hypothesis: Yiudan yi resawam. Monsuo nam akɔ mantu. Ɔkyina mmɔfiri adi nkosua wɔn. Nea ɔradeɛ baadi ma ɛkyi.

reference: Nso akyinnyeɛ biara nni mu sɛ deɛ ɔkyɛne soɔ no na ɔhyira akumaa.
hypothesis: Nso, kyinniiɛ bi animu sɛ deɛ ɔkyɛ no soɔ no na ɔhyira akuma.

reference: Na Hesekia hyɛɛ sɛ wɔnsiesie mpumpunu AWURADE fie; na wɔsiesiee, na wɔde mmasoɔ adeɛ no ne ntotosoɔ du du no ne akronkronneɛ no hyɛɛ hɔ nokorɛdie so.
hypothesis: Nahedzike ahyɛɛsɛ, wɔn siase mpampan awuradi fie na wɔsiesie. Na wɔde masoɔ adeɛ no ne ntotosua dodoɔ no ne akonkonnwa no hyɛɛ hɔ no kura adeɛ so.

reference: Ɛnsɛ sɛ saa onipa no susu sɛ ɔbɛnya biribiara afiri Awurade nkyɛn; nʼadwene yɛ no ntanta a ɔntumi nsi biribiara pi.
hypothesis: Ɛnsesesaw nnipa no sisi sisi sɛ ɔbɛnyɛ biribi afiri awurade nkyɛn. Na dwene yɛ ntantan a ɔntumi nsi biribi ap .

reference: Mo a moka sɛ: Ɛnnɛ ne ɔkyena yɛbɛkɔ sɛɛ ne sɛɛ kuro yi mu akɔdi hɔ afe, na yɛatɔ atɔn na yɛanya mfasoɔ.
hypothesis: Mmoa mɔka sɛ nna ne wɔn kyen ayɛbɛkɔ sɛ ne sɛ kuro yi mu akodeɛ hɔ afe na yɛatɔ atɔn na yɛanya mfasoɔ.

reference: Na ɔhwɛ ne ho na ɔkɔ, na ntɛm ara na ne werɛ afiri su ko a ɔkura.
hypothesis: Na ɔhwɛ ne ho na ɔkɔ na ntɛmua na ne nwira fi sukuu a okura.

reference: Ne nneyɛeɛ maa Onyankopɔn buu no bem, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔgyee Yudafoɔ bi a wɔsomaa wɔn, boaa wɔn ma wɔdwane faa ɛkwan foforɔ bi so.
hypothesis: N'ani yɛma wɔ nyanko pɔn bo no bi mu, efi sɛ ɔde yidafoɔ bi a wɔsom a wɔn, boa a wɔn ma wɔadwa no fa a ɛkwan foforɔ bi so.

reference: Na deɛ wɔkari de yɛɛ nnadewa no ano si sika nnwetɛbena aduonum.
hypothesis: Adeɛ ɔka redi na adowa no ano si sika ne tabuna aduane no mu.

reference: Ɔdii mfeɛ aduonu nnum na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ dunsia wɔ Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Ode mfeɛ aduane num na ɔbɛdi ahene. Na ɔde ahene mfeɛ de nsia wɔ yere sɛ lɛn.

reference: Abɔfoɔ no kyinii nkuro a ɛwɔ Efraim ne Manase kɔsi Sebulon so.
hypothesis: Abɔfoɔ no twene kuro a ɛwɔ afirim. Ne ma no ase kɔsi sɛ bowl ɔsɔ.

reference: Afei m’ani bɛbue na mayɛ aso mama ɛha yi mpaebɔ.
hypothesis: Afem eni bebree na ma yɛ aso ma ma ɛha yi mpa bɔ.

reference: Afe no ahyɛaseɛ no, Aram akodɔm bɔɔ nsra baa Yoas so.
hypothesis: Afunu ahyia aseɛ no, ɛra akodɔn bɔɔl nsra akɔ yi wa so.

reference: Manase ne Efraim nkurɔfoɔ ne Israel nkaeɛfoɔ nyinaa ne Yuda ne Benyamin ne Yerusalemfoɔ na wɔde akyɛdeɛ no baeɛ.
hypothesis: Mmaaase ne afirimkurofoɔ ne adwira nkaefoɔ nyinaa ne ndwomadie ne banyam na na ɔde akyɛdeɛ no bye.

reference: Nanso, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ, ‘Ɛyɛ sɛ wopɛ sɛ wosi asɔredan de hyɛ me din animuonyam nanso, ɛnyɛ wo na wobɛyɛ.
hypothesis: N'aso ɔde kakyeɛ ne sɛ ɛyɛ sɛ ɛwɔ pɛsɛ wusi asɔre dan de hyɛ mbidie ne mu nyɛn n'aso ɛnyɛ wɔn a ɔbɛyɛ.

reference: Enti momma yɛmmɔ mmɔden nhyɛne ɔhome no mu, na obi anhwe ase anyɛ asoɔden korɔ no ara ho nhwɛsoɔ.
hypothesis: Kente, mumayamɔmɔden, nhyɛn ne ɔhome no mu, na obi a nhwɛ ase a n’ase hɔ de nkuruwa no ara ho hwɛ soro.

reference: Saa ɛberɛ yi, na asɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ hɔ no nyinaa, sɛ wɔwɔ dwuma bi die anaa wɔnni hwee yɛ, adwira wɔn ho.
hypothesis: Tibre na asɔfo a wɔwɔ hɔ no nyinaa saw wɔ dwuma bi deɛ anaa wɔn hweeɛ adwira wɔn ho.

reference: Wɔyi Ɔsɔfopanin biara firi nnipa bi mu na wasi wɔn ananmu de wɔn akyɛdeɛ ne wɔn bɔne ho afɔdeɛ asom Onyankopɔn.
hypothesis: Woyiɔ asɔfopanin bi refiri nnipa bi mu. Na wɔasi wɔn anan mu de wɔn akyɛdeɛ ne wɔn bɔ ne ho afodeɛ asɔ wɔn nyɔnko pɔn.

reference: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Yɛ komm, fa wo nsa mua w’ano na ɛne yɛn nkɔ, na yɛ yɛn agya ne ɔsɔfoɔ.
hypothesis: Nnipa a ɔka kyerɛ no sɛ yɛ kɔn mu. Fa ɔnsamu a wɔn ano na ne yɛ nkɔ. Na wɔregya ne ɔsɔfoɔ.

reference: Wɔn agya maa wɔn mu biara akyɛdeɛ a ɛsom bo, a ɛyɛ dwetɛ, sikakɔkɔɔ ne aboɔdenneɛ, na afei, ɔde Yuda nkuro a wɔabɔ ho ban no bi kyekyɛɛ wɔn.
hypothesis: Wɔn agyam a wɔn mu biara akyɛdeɛ a ɛsono bɔ a ɛyɛ dwetɛ sika kɔkɔɔ ne aboɔdeneɛ, na afei, wɔde yi da nkuro a wɔabɔ ho ban no bi kyehyɛ wɔn.

reference: Na Samson kaa sɛ: Ma me ne Filistifoɔ no nwuwu!
hypothesis: Asramsɛn kaa sɛ maame no afristifoɔ no mu.

reference: Na wɔfaa adaka no ne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne akronkronneɛ a ɛwɔ ntomadan no mu nyinaa bae; Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ no na wɔde foro baeɛ.
hypothesis: Nnwofo adaka no ne ahyia yɛ ntomadan ne ne akonkorɔniwa a ɛwɔ  ntomadan no mu nyinaa abae. Lɛɛfiw asɔfoɔ no na ɔdeforo bae.

reference: W’asɔfoɔ no, AWURADE Nyankopɔn, ma wɔnhyɛ nkwagyeɛ.
hypothesis: Wasɔfoɔ no, awurade nyɛangpɔn ma wɔnhyɛ nkwadie.

reference: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ampa, mɛdi w’akyi na woakum Midian sɛ onipa baako.
hypothesis: Dɛ rɛde katerɛ no sɛ mpa, me du wɔ akyi na wɔreko media ase onipa baako.

reference: Nanso, Samson ka kyerɛɛ nʼagya sɛ, “Kɔyɛ ne ho adeɛ ma me.
hypothesis: Nanso, santsen kakyee ne gya sɛ kwae ne ho adeɛ ma ma.

reference: Nnipa a wɔyɛɛ bɔne na wɔtete hwe wuwuu wɔ ɛserɛ so no.
hypothesis: Nnipa a wɔyɛ abɔne no, wɔtete hweewowow wɔ ɛsrɛ so no.

reference: Na wo ara, wo nko ara na wonim nnipa mma akoma mu, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔasuro woɔ, na woanante w’akwan soɔ nna a wɔde bɛtena asase a wode maa yɛn agyanom no soɔ no nyinaa.
hypothesis: Nawoara, nko ara na wɔn anim nnipa ma akoma mu. Deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔsoro hɔ na wɔn ano nso wɔakɔ asoro no a wɔde bɛtena asase a wɔde ma yɛn agyanom nso nyinaa.

reference: Na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sei na monyɛ wɔ AWURADE ho suro mu, nokorɛ ne mo akoma mu.
hypothesis: Ɛhyɛ wɔn sɛ sɛ namanya a ɔradeɛ ho soro mu. N'akura no mu akoma mu.

reference: Na afei masoma ɔbarima nyansafoɔ a ɔwɔ nhunumu a ɔne Huram-Abi.
hypothesis: N'afee mmason mbɔrema nyansafoɔ a wɔnhunu mu a ɔne huram abien.

reference: Mɛma wɔayɛ nsɛsodeɛ ne ohoni a wɔagu de ahyɛ me babarima animuonyam.
hypothesis: Mmarima a wɔyɛ nsasodeɛ ne ohonin a wɔgu deɛ ahyɛn me ba barima ne monyam.

reference: Na Yerusalem nso, Yehosafat de Lewifoɔ ne asɔfoɔ ne Israel agyanom atitire no mu binom sisii AWURADE atemmuo ne asennie so.
hypothesis: Ayaresalam so, yɛhɔ safɛt de la refua ne asɔfoɔ no yi sraa agya no mu atitire no mu binom sisi awuradeɛ atɛ mu ne ase no yɛ so.

reference: “Merebrɛ wo odwumfoɔ a ne nsa ano adwuma yɛ fɛ a wɔfrɛ no Huram-Abi.
hypothesis: Mmɛbrɛ wɔ adwumfoɔ a ne saa no adwumayɛ fɛ a wɔfrɛ no huram abere.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Aaron mma, asɔfoɔ no, sɛ wɔmmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ AWURADE afɔrebukyia no so.
hypothesis: Nnwaka kyerɛ ɛyereɛ ɔrema. Asɔfoɔ no sɛ wɔn a wɔhyiafoɔ deɛ wɔ awuradeɛ afɔrebu kyiaa no so.

reference: Na ɔte Debora kyiresua ase, Rama ne Betel ntam, Efraim bepɔ so; na Israelfoɔ foro ba ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔmmu wɔn atɛn.
hypothesis: Nɔɔte de wura kyerɛsua ase. Rɔma ne bɛtɔn tam efiri mbepɔ so. Na ɛsraafoɔ no foro ba ne nkyɛnse a ɛwɔ mu wɔ atɛn.

reference: Na ɛpo no si wɔn so ɔsoro, na wɔn akyiri nyinaa wɔ emu fam.
hypothesis: Nnipa no si wɔn so ɔsoro. Na wɔn akyi no nyinaa wɔ ɛmu fam.

reference: Ɛnna ɔhene no frɛɛ Ɔpanin Yehoiada, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na womma Lewifoɔ no nnye Yuda ne Yerusalem toɔ a AWURADE akoa Mose ne Israel badwa no hyɛ maa adanseɛ ntomadan no?
hypothesis: Ana ahenofra a ɔpanyin yi ho ada n'ɔka kyerɛ no sɛ adeɛ ntena wɔn alɛyifoɔ no ɛnyɛ yi dan yi yɛresa mtoa a awurade akua amosi ne ndzura a ebedwa ahyɛ ma adansie ntoma dan no.

reference: Na Gileadni Yefta yɛ ɔbarima a ɔyɛ nnam, nanso ɔyɛ ɔbaa dwamamfoɔ bi ba, na Gilead na ɔwoo Yefta.
hypothesis: Nagyilla no yɛ fitaa yɛ ɔbarima a ɔyɛ nam, na nso ɔyɛ ɔbaa dwamanfoɔ bi ba. Na agyilla no a ɔwɔ yɛ fitaa.

reference: Asɔrefie sie no mfitiaseɛ.
hypothesis: Akwantasɔ mmienu te mmiɛnsa. Asɔrefie asie no mfitaa asie.

reference: Na Gideon hunuu sɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE bɔfoɔ no, Gideon kaa sɛ: Ao, AWURADE Nyankopɔn!
hypothesis: Ayi dɔm wusɛr ade bɔfoɔ no, gyina nkaesɛe a ɔwera ade nyɛnko pɔn.

reference: Ɛberɛ a Amonfoɔ to hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ so, Gilead mpanimfoɔ soma kɔfaa Yefta firii Tob asase so baeɛ.
hypothesis: Ɛbrɛ a amamfoɔ hyɛ adwrafoɔ so. Gila de mpanimfoɔ asoma kɔfa a wɔyɛ fitaa. Firitob asase so ban.

reference: Yeinom ne wɔn a wɔsom ɔhene no, ɛsono wɔn a ɔhene de wɔn duaduaa Yuda nyinaa mu nkuro a ɛyɛ den no mu no.
hypothesis: Yɛn mu ne wɔn a wɔsom ɔhene no. Ɛsono wɔn a ɔhene de wɔn duadua yi da nyinaa mu nkuro a ɛdan no mu no.

reference: Na Sisera maa wɔkɔpae hyiahyiaa ne nteaseɛnam a ɛyɛ dadeɛ nteaseɛnam ahankron no nyinaa ne ɔman a wɔka ne ho nyinaa de firi Haroset-hagoyim baa Kison nsunoa.
hypothesis: N'asesan ama ɔkɔ pae hyihyia ne nteasean ama yɛ dadeɛ nteasean ama hankoro no nyinaa ne ɔmae a ɔka ne ho nyinaa de firi hareset hagu ayi mu. Baakisi wɔn su noa.

reference: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Misraimfoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Amonfoɔ, Filistifoɔ, Sidonfoɔ, Amalekfoɔ ne Maonfoɔ anhyɛ mo so!
hypothesis: Narwadaka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ, mosirifoɔ, ammorifoɔ, amanfoɔ, filisifoɔ, sdɔmfoɔ, ammɛlɛfoɔ ne mmoaafoɔ a nhyɛ mosoɔ.

reference: Ɔno deɛ, honam nsa na ɛne no wɔ hɔ, na yɛn deɛ, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn na ɔne yɛn wɔ hɔ, sɛ ɔbɛboa yɛn na wako yɛn ko ama yɛn.
hypothesis: Ɔno deɛ, ɔnam nsa na ɛne no wɔ hɔ, na yɛn deɛ, awuradeɛ anyiwa wɔpon na ɔne yɛn wɔ hɔ. Saa ɔbɛboa yɛn na akonwa nkɔn ama yɛn.

reference: Na Onyankopɔn yɛɛ saa, anadwo no, na enwi no nko woe, na fam hɔ nyinaa, obosuo tɔ guu hɔ.
hypothesis: Dɔɔnya kɔkɔɔ yi yɛ saa anaa adwono na ndwii no nko wɔ yi na fam hɔ nyinaa ɔbɔ so tɔgu hɔ.

reference: Na ɔsomaa abɔfoɔ maa wɔkɔɔ Aser ne Sebulon ne Naftali, na wɔforo ba bɛhyiaa no.
hypothesis: N'asomabofoɔ mmaa ɔrekɔ, asɛ ne sɛ blu ne naftali. Na ɔfroba besia no.

reference: Na ɔte Debora kyiresua ase, Rama ne Betel ntam, Efraim bepɔ so; na Israelfoɔ foro ba ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔmmu wɔn atɛn.
hypothesis: Nɔɔte de wura kyerɛsua ase. Rɔma ne bɛtɔn tam efiri mbepɔ so. Na ɛsraafoɔ no foro ba ne nkyɛnse a ɛwɔ mu wɔ atɛn.

reference: Na hwɛ, na Sisera da hɔ awu, na pɛɛwa no tua n’asontorɔ mu.
hypothesis: N'ahyɛ, n'ahesɛn a adahoaa wu. N'apɛ a wɔano tuo a n'aso nturo mu.

reference: Ɛnna ɔman no de wɔn ho too Yudahene Hesekia nsɛm no soɔ.
hypothesis: Ɛna ɔman no de wɔn ho toɔ yi dan ne hwadakia nsam no so.

reference: Kɔbere mfrafraeɛ a wɔde dii dwuma no dodoɔ enti, wɔantumi anhunu emu duru ano.
hypothesis: Kɔbrɛ mfrafraeɛ a wɔde di dwuma no dodoɔnti. Wɔn ntumi ehu ɛmu duano.

reference: Asɔredan a merebɛsi no kɛseɛ ne ne fɛ a ɛbɛyɛ enti, nnua bebree ho bɛhia me.
hypothesis: Asɔredan a mmabasini kɛseɛ ne neɛɛfɛ a ɛbɛyɛnti. Nnua bebree ho bɛyɛma.

reference: Ɛnna wɔfaa safoa de hiniiɛ, na hwɛ, na wɔn wura da fam awu.
hypothesis: Ɛna ɔfura asafoɔ de hene n'ahyɛ na wɔn hura da fam agorɔ.

reference: Na wɔhwiee sika a wɔhunuu no AWURADE fie no guu hɔ, na wɔde hyɛɛ ahwɛfoɔ no ne wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no nsa.
hypothesis: Nwohiei asika a wohu no, awurade fie no gu hɔ. Na wɔde hyɛ ahwɛfoɔ no ne wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no nsa.

reference: Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ yii ne ho kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, woyɛ obonini na wonwo, nanso wobɛnyinsɛn awo ɔbabarima.
hypothesis: Naradeɛbɔfoɔ yi na wɔtena ɔbaa no. Na ɔka tena no sɛ  hwɛ. Ɔyɛ obonin na ɔwɔ hɔ. Na nso bɛnye nsia wɔ ɔba barima.

reference: Na Amorifoɔ hyeɛ firi Akrabim aforoeɛ, ɛfiri Sela rekorɔ no.
hypothesis: Nam a orifo ahyia afiri akra bi afɔɔyɛ. Efiri sɛlaa koro no.

reference: Na ɔne wɔn tenaa Nyankopɔn fie, huntaa mfeɛ nsia.
hypothesis: Ɔne hɔn tsena anya ahopɔw fie. Kuta mfie nsia.

reference: Mfeɛ dunwɔtwe na wɔdii Israelfoɔ a wɔwɔ Yordan agya, Amorifoɔ asase soɔ wɔ Gilead no nyinaa soɔ.
hypothesis: Mfie no wɔtwe no a wɔde resere a wɔwɔ yɔda ne gya. Ambrɛfoɔ asase soɔ, wɔgu liad no nyinaa so.

reference: Enti, Awurade abufuo baa ɔno, Yuda ne Yerusalem nyinaa so.
hypothesis: Nti ɛradeɛ abufuɔ baa ɔno, yi dan yi yere sɛlem nyinaa so.

reference: Ɔdaa hɔ ara kɔsii sɛ anim teteeɛ.
hypothesis: Wɔde akronu abɔnten kɛseɛ so, na obiara aforo wɔn ankorɔfie, ankɔso wɔn hɔ hɔ.

reference: Me nuanom monhwɛ yie na mo mu bi annya akoma bɔne a ɔrennye Onyankopɔn nni na ɛbɛma watwe ne ho afiri Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no ho.
hypothesis: Mehunu ano, mu hwɛ yie, na mu mu bi a nya akomaboni a ɔne wɔn nyanko pɔn ani, na ɔbɛma watwe ne ho afiri wɔn nyanko pɔn tiri asofoɔ no ho.

reference: Momfa wɔn sɛ nhwɛsoɔ wɔ wɔn boasetɔ ne tumi a wɔtumi de tenaa amanehunu mu no.
hypothesis: Nwomfa wɔn sɛ nhwasoɔ wɔ wɔn bo ase to. Ne tumi a wɔtumi de tena ama ne ho no mu no.

reference: Ɛnna Amasia bisaa Nyankopɔn nipa no sɛ: Na ɛdeɛn na yɛnyɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha a mede ama Israel asafo no?
hypothesis: Ɛna amansia bi sa a nyawɔpon nnipa no sɛ nea adeɛ a n'enyiwa gyede kɛseɛ ɔhaa ma ɛde ama Israel asafoɔ no.

reference: Israelfoɔ no somm Moabhene Eglon mfirinhyia dunwɔtwe.
hypothesis: Adwadifoɔ no sumaa bi ne aguramfirihyia do wɔtwe.

reference: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Misraimfoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Amonfoɔ, Filistifoɔ, Sidonfoɔ, Amalekfoɔ ne Maonfoɔ anhyɛ mo so!
hypothesis: Narwadaka kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ, mosirifoɔ, ammorifoɔ, amanfoɔ, filisifoɔ, sdɔmfoɔ, ammɛlɛfoɔ ne mmoaafoɔ a nhyɛ mosoɔ.

reference: Mprɛnsa ni a woasisi me, na wonkyerɛɛ me adekodeɛ a w’ahoɔden kɛseɛ yi wɔ mu.
hypothesis: Mperensa no yi a wɔasisi mu na wɔn nkyerɛw mu yi adekodeɛ a wɔn ho adan kɛseɛ yi wɔ mu.

reference: Ɛda bi, ɔde ɔbaa bi firi Betlehem a ɛwɔ Yuda baa fie sɛ ne mpena.
hypothesis: Ɔda bi, ɔde ɔbaa bi firi bɛkyerɛ yɛm a ɛwɔ yi da ba afiesa ne mpena.

reference: Na wɔn mma deɛ, wankum wɔn, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no mmara no mu, Mose nwoma mu no a AWURADE hyɛɛ sɛ: Agyanom nnwu, mma nti, na mma nso nnwu, agyanom nti, na onipa no ara bɔne nti na wɔmma no nwuo.
hypothesis: Nna wɔn adeɛ wɔn kum wɔn. Sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ nɔmbranom. Ma ɔn nsa wɔn mma mu no a awuradeɛ shɛɛfɛ gya no mu wɔ mma no ti. Na mma nso nwɔ wɔn agya no mu ti. Na onipa noa abɔ ne nti na wɔn mma no wɔ wɔn akyi.

reference: Na wɔkɔfrɛɛ Samson firii apokyerɛfoɔ fie bae, na ɔgoroo wɔn anim, na wɔde no gyinaa adum no ntam.
hypothesis: Nwɔrekɔfrɛ a samsefiri, apɔkyerɛfoɔ fie baa na wɔregoro wɔn anim. Na wɔde no gyina ɛdum no ntɛm.

reference: Ɛnna AWURADE abufuo dɛre tiaa Israel, na ɔtɔn wɔn hyɛɛ Mesopotamia hene Kusan-risataim nsa, na Israelfoɔ som Kusan-risataim mfirinhyia nwɔtwe.
hypothesis: Ɛna rɛde abufuo da retia Israel. Na ɔtɔn hɔn hyɛ mmasupɔtɛɛmia. Hene kusam resa tam sa. Na ɛsraafoɔ no so kusam resa tam mfimfinihyia wɔtwe.

reference: Na sɛ mobisa koraa nso a, mo nsa renka, ɛfiri sɛ, mowɔ adwemmɔne.
hypothesis: Nasamu bi sa koraa so a, wɔn nsa ankaa fi sɛ wɔadwɛmbɔ no.

reference: Na ɔsanee sɛ ɔrekɔsa ne ho yadeɛ Yesreel afiri pira a ɔne Siriahene Hasael reko no, wɔpirapiraa no Rama no mu.
hypothesis: Nsane sɛ ɔrekɔsane ho yɛadeɛ Israel afiri pra a ɔne syiriwa ahene ha sɛ ɛrekɔ no. Wɔapirapira no raman no mu.

reference: Ɛnna Salomo boaa Israel mpanimfoɔ ne mmusuakuo no atitire ne Israelfoɔ mu agyanom mmapɔmma no ano bɛhyiaa Yerusalem, sɛ wɔrekɔfa AWURADE apam adaka no afiri Dawid kuro a ɛne Sion no mu aba.
hypothesis: Ɛna Salɔmanboa a Israel mpanimfoɔ ne musuakuo ne atitire ne Israelfoɔ mu agya no ma pɔrima no ano bɛhyia a yereise nam. Saa ɛwɔ ɔkɔfa awuradeɛ apama adaka no afiri Dawid Kuro a ɛne seiyɔ no mu aba.

reference: Enti Lewifoɔ no siesiee wɔn ara wɔn deɛ ne asɔfoɔ, Aaron mma no deɛ.
hypothesis: Ntilewifoɔ no asiesie wɔn ara wɔn deɛ ne asɔfoɔ rewrama no deɛ.

reference: Na Samson ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wɔde nhomamono nson a ɛnwoeɛ kyekyere me a, ɛnneɛ mɛhodwo, na mayɛ sɛ onipa biara.
hypothesis: Asansin kakra no sɛ sɛ wɔde nhoma a ɔmo no nso a ɛnwɔ yɛkyekyere mia ɛne ɛmɛho dwu na ma yɛsi onipa biara.

reference: Na merenkɔ so mentwe Israel nan mfiri asase a mahyɛ ama wɔn agyanom no so: Hwɛ ara nko na wɔnhwɛ nyɛ adeɛ a mahyɛ wɔn no nyinaa, Mose nsa ano mmara ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ nyinaa.
hypothesis: Maame nkwasoɔ mbɛntwi redi nan afiri asase a wɔahyɛ ama wɔn agya no so. Hyɛn no kura wɔnhyɛn adeɛ a wɔahyɛ wɔn no nyinaa. Mbɔɔsa nsa no mbra ne ahwɛdeɛ ne atabodie nyinaa.

reference: Na wɔsɔre yiyii afɔrebukyia a ɛwowɔ Yerusalem no, na aduhwamhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no nyinaa nso wɔyiyii, na wɔkɔto guu asuwa Kidron mu.
hypothesis: Nwɔsɔre yi afa rebukyia a ɛwowɔ yreselam no. Na adiwamhyia afa rebukyia no nyinaa nso wɔ yie. Na ɔkotow gu asua kodrom.

reference: Salomo kan ahɔhoɔ dodoɔ a wɔwɔ Israel asase so, te sɛ deɛ nʼagya kenkanee nnipa no.
hypothesis: Salamu kan ahohoa dodoɔ a wɔwɔ adwaasase so. Te sɛ deɛ n'agya kan no nipa no.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wode me tirinwi mpɛsɛmpɛsɛ nson de fra ntomaban nwono a.
hypothesis: Nnipa a ɔka kyerɛ no sɛ, sɛ ɔde ne tiri nnipa mpɛsɛmpɛsɛnso de fra ntomaban nwona.

reference: Mʼabusua na ɛyɛ mmerɛ koraa wɔ Manase abusuakuo mu na me na mesua koraa wɔ me fiefoɔ nyinaa mu.
hypothesis: Mbusua na ɛyɛ mberɛ koraa wɔ ma no asɛ abusua kuo mu. Na mbenyin bi nso koraa wɔn efiefoɔ nyinaa.

reference: Na Nebukadnessar yii Yehoiakyin wɔfa Sedekia, sɛ ɔnni ɔhene wɔ Yuda ne Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Naneebu kaneda yi wɔakye hɔ fa sedeke a sɛ wɔn ani ɔhene wɔ yi da ne yere sɛ lɛn.

reference: Na asase no sofoɔ no faa Yosia ba Yehoahas sii no hene n’agya ananmu Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Na asase no sofoɔ no fa a yɛasi aba yɛhua ha asie no, ɛhene n’agya anan mu, yɛresalam.

reference: Enti, wɔde anigyeɛ kamfoo Awurade, na wɔkoto sɔreeɛ.
hypothesis: Nti, wɔde anigyeɛ kanfoɔ ade na wɔkoto sɔre.

reference: Na ɛno akyiri no ɛbaa Yoas akoma mu sɛ ɔbɛsiesie AWURADE fie no foforɔ.
hypothesis: Nanua akyire no, abaayewa wɔ asaako ma ɛmu sɛ ɔbɛsiesie ɛwura ade fie no foforɔ.

reference: Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, sɛdeɛ n’agya Usia yɛeɛ no ara.
hypothesis: Nyɛɛdeɛ ɛtene ɛwura adeɛ ne so sɛdeɛ ne gya yusi a yɛn no ara.

reference: Ɛnna ɔbarima Lewini a ɔyɛ ɔbaa a wɔdii no awuo no kunu no buaa sɛ: Meduruu Gibea a ɛyɛ Benyamin deɛ no mu, me ne me mpena no, na yɛbɛdaa hɔ.
hypothesis: Ɛna ɔbarima lɛɛweni a ɔyɛ ɔbaa a wɔdi no ɛwɔ no kunu no boa a sɛɛ. Duro gyi bi a ɛyɛ bɛyɛ mmɛndiɛ no mu. Mɛne mpena no, na yɛbɛda hɔ.

reference: Na asase no so dwoo mfeɛ aduanan.
hypothesis: N'ahyɛ asa no so dew mfeɛ adua nan.

reference: Nsuo pa ne nsuo a ɛyɛ nkyenenkyene bɛtumi afiri asutire baako mu aba?
hypothesis: Nsuo paa ne nsuo a ɛyɛ nkyerɛkyerɛni bi tuntum afiri sutiri baako mu aba .

reference: Na ɔfaa asɔfoɔ no ho abufuo no, kwata fifirii ne moma so, asɔfoɔ no anim, AWURADE fie hɔ, aduhwamhyeɛbukyia no ho.
hypothesis: N'afa a asɔfoɔ no ho abofoɔ no, kwatafire ne moma so, asɔfoɔ no anim, awuradze fie hɔ. Edwumayɛ nhyiamu kyia ne ho.

reference: Afei, wɔfaa nnadeɛ adwumfoɔ maa wɔde nnadeɛ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ yɛɛ Awurade Asɔredan no ho nneɛma.
hypothesis: Afeefoɔ anaa adwumfoɔ ma wɔde nnadeɛ ne kɔbrɛ mfrafra yi reyɛ asɔre dan ne ho nneɛma.

reference: Na Hesekia kaa sɛ: Afei moadwira mo ho ama AWURADE, montwe mpini, na momfa okum afɔdeɛ ne aseda afɔdeɛ mmra AWURADE fie.
hypothesis: Nahedzekyɛ a ɛka aseɛ, afee mma dwura mahoa ma awurade, muntwim pene na mma mma okuma fɔdeɛ ne asedaa fɔdeɛ mmerɛ awurade fie.

reference: Na wɔretwentwɛn wɔn nan aseɛ no, Ehud dwanee, na ɔbɛsianee ahoni no ho, na ɔdwane baa Seira.
hypothesis: Nn ɔrekyerɛ wɔn aseɛ no ɛhudwane na ɔbesane ahonin no ho na ɔdwane baa siara.

reference: Enti monyi efi ne bɔne nyinaa nto ntwene, na momfa ɔdwoɔ nnye asɛm a wɔatɛ no mo mu a ɛbɛtumi agye mo kra no.
hypothesis: Ntomoni efi ne borɔne nyinaa ntontontwene, na mmɔfra ɔdwaɔ no asɛm a wɔatɛ no momuu a ebetumi agye mmɔkra no.

reference: Na Huram yɛɛ nsenaa ne sesa adeɛ ne nkoraa no nso.
hypothesis: Nahura mmeɛnsa na ne sesa adeɛ no nkura no so.

reference: Na Yudafoɔ nyinaa gyinagyina AWURADE anim, wɔn ne wɔn mma nketewa, wɔn yerenom ne wɔn mma.
hypothesis: Ayyidafoɔ nyinaa gyinagyina awuradeɛ anim. Wɔne wɔn mma nketewa. Wɔn enyi nom ne wɔn mma.

reference: Ɛno enti na Awurade, ne Onyankopɔn, maa Aramhene kwan dii Ahas so nkonim, twaa ne nkurɔfoɔ bebree asuo kɔɔ Damasko no.
hypothesis: Anunti na ɛrade ne nyɛn kɔpɔn mu a ɛra mhwene kwan di ɛha aso nkunim. Twene nkurɔfoɔ bebree asuo kɔ dɛ mask no.

reference: Yotam dii mfeɛ aduonu nnum na ɔbɛdii hene, na ɔdii hene mfeɛ dunsia wɔ Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Yɛtam de mfie adua no num na ɔbɛdi hene. Na ɔdi hene mfie adua nsia wɔ yɛresalam.

reference: Na awufoɔ a ɔmaa wɔwuiɛ ne wuo mu dɔɔso sene wɔn a ɔmaa wɔwuiɛ ne nkwa berɛ mu.
hypothesis: Nahofoɔ a wɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ no wɔn mu dɔɔso sene wɔn a wɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ no ne nkwabere mu.

reference: Ma memfa enwi no mensɔ menhwɛ prɛko yi bio, ma enwi no nko nwo na obosuo ntɔ ngu fam hɔ nyinaa.
hypothesis: Maamefa nwii no mmiɛnsa ɛna nhyɛ mprakonin bio. Ma nwii no nko, nwona ɔbɔ soɔ, ntɔngu fam hɔ nyinaa.

reference: “Na wo deɛ, sɛ wodi mʼakyi sɛdeɛ wʼagya Dawid yɛeɛ, na wotie mʼahyɛdeɛ, di me mmara nyinaa so a, meremma obiara mfa wʼahennwa nkɔ.
hypothesis: Nawodeɛ, sawodum akyi sɛdeɛ wagya da rediɛ, na wotie ma hyɛdeɛ de mmimra nyinaa so a mmarima a obiara afa wɔn hɛn ngo ankorɔ.

reference: Enti, Awurade maa Asiriafoɔ akodɔm bɛfaa Manase yɛɛ no ɔdeduani.
hypothesis: Nti ɛradɛma asraafoɔ akodɔn bɛframba no ase yɛ no ɔde dua ni.

reference: Na osuo antɔ asase so mfeɛ mmiɛnsa ne abosome nsia.
hypothesis: Na osuo a ntɔ asase nso mfeɛ mmiɛnsa ne abɔ so mmiɛnsa.

reference: Sɛ motumi kyerɛ me aseɛ nnanson apontoɔ yi mu na mohunu a, ɛnneɛ mɛma mo nkamisaa aduasa ne ntadeɛ nsakyeraho aduasa; na sɛ moantumi ankyerɛ me a, mo nso momma me nkamisaa aduasa ne ntadeɛ nsakyeraho aduasa.
hypothesis: Tamutu mikyerɛ me aseɛ nnan so apuntuo yi mu namuhunu a ɛne mmarima mu nkramisaa dua aseɛ ne ntaadeɛ nsa kyerɛ ho adua aseɛ. Na aseɛ no mu ntumi akyerɛ mea, wɔn nso momma me nkramisaa dua aseɛ ne ntaadeɛ nsa kyerɛ ho adua aseɛ.

reference: Me mmuaeɛ ne sɛ, “Kyerɛ me sɛdeɛ obi tumi nya gyidie a nneyɛeɛ mmata ho ase.
hypothesis: Mmimu a yɛnesɛ kyerɛmisa deɛ obi tumi nyɛ agyedie a ne yɛ mmata ho ase.

reference: Na ɔsane firi kɔɔ ɔman no mu de firii Beer-seba kɔsii Efraim bepɔ so, na ɔdanee wɔ sane baa AWURADE wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn no nkyɛn.
hypothesis: Norosan afiri kɔ ɔman no mu de afiri bɛɛsɛ baako si afiri mpaboa so. Norosan no mu no, ɔdan no mu no, ɔsane bɛyɛ awuradze anigye anum ne akɔpɔn nkyɛn.

reference: Na afei a AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn atu Amorifoɔ afiri ne man Israel anim yi, wo na wobɛfa adi soɔ anaa?
hypothesis: N'afee a ɛwɔ adi ɛsra akyɛn a ɛko pɔto a abɔ ɛfiri ne ma ɛsra anim yi. Wɔn a wɔbɛfo ase ase adi so anaa.

reference: ” Enti ɔhene no maa nʼasomfoɔ no nyinaa yɛɛ dinn na ɔmaa wɔn nyinaa firii ɛdan mu hɔ.
hypothesis: Ohenem a n'asomfoɔ no nyinaa yɛ dan yi, na wɔn nyinaa firi dan mu hɔ.

reference: Nna no mu no, na ɔhene biara nni Israel; na nna no mu nso na Danfoɔ abusuakuo no rehwehwɛ agyapadeɛ atena so, ɛfiri sɛ ɛde bɛsi saa berɛ no na agyapadeɛ bi nnya mmɛtɔɔ wɔn fam Israel mmusuakuo no mu.
hypothesis: Nanomono, na ɔhene bi ani srae, na nananomono nso, n'adamfoɔ abusu akuo no rehwehwɛ agyapadeɛ tena so. Mfiri sɛ, adeɛ bɛsi sɛ aberɛ no na agyapadeɛ bi nyama tɔɔ. Wɔframma ɛsrae abusu akuo no mu.

reference: Ɛnna asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no sɔreeɛ na wɔhyiraa ɔman no.
hypothesis: Ɛna asɔfoɔ no rewifoɔ no sɔre yɛ na wɔhyira ɔman no.

reference: Na wɔtii Midian na wɔde Oreb ne Seeb tiri firi Yordan agya brɛɛ Gideon.
hypothesis: Nnɔteɛmidie no, na ɔde ɔrebɛni si trifi yɛda ne gya brɛ gu ne ho.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wɔde ntampehoma foforɔ a wɔmfa nyɛɛ adwuma da kyekyere me a, ɛnna mɛhodwo mayɛ sɛ onipa biara.
hypothesis: Nnɔka kyerɛ no sɛ sɛ ɔde ntampe nwoma foforɔ a wɔfɛ anya adwuma da tete remia, ɛna mehunu dwo, maa yɛ sɛ onipa biara.

reference: Na Yuda tu kɔe, na AWURADE de Kanaanfoɔ ne Perisifoɔ no hyɛɛ ne nsa, na wɔkum nnipa mpem du wɔ Besek.
hypothesis: Aya da to kɔɔ yi, na ɛrade de kanamfoɔ ne pear si foɔ no hyɛ ne nsa. Na okunu nnipa mpim bi wɔ bi sɛ .

reference: Na Hesekia dii yie ne nneyɛɛ nyinaa mu.
hypothesis: N'ahyɛhɛ adeɛ yie na ne yɛn nyinaa mu.

reference: Biribiara nni adaka no mu gye aboɔpono mmienu a Mose de guu mu Horeb, faako a AWURADE ne Israelfoɔ pameeɛ berɛ a wɔfiri Misraim asase so reba no.
hypothesis: Bibirem ne adaka no mu gye aboa pono mmienu a wɔresi de guamu ɔrebɔ. Faako a ɛwura ade ne Israelfoɔ pa mu yɛ. Berɛ a wɔfiri mbr. Mbr. Asaso ɛreba no.

reference: Ɔdwirii nnuhwam afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ Israelman mu nyinaa, na ɔsane kɔɔ Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Odwiri nnhwa afɔre bukyia a ɛwɔ adwuraman no mu nyinaa. Na ɔsan kɔ yere sɛlep.

reference: Afei, Lewifoɔ no faa Dawid nnwontodeɛ no kɔgyinagyinaa wɔn gyinaberɛ wɔ Asɔredan no ho.
hypothesis: Afee lɛwufoɔ ne faadeɛ wɔ nyɔntodeɛ no wɔ gyinagyina wɔn gyina berɛ wɔn asordan no ho.

reference: Ɛnam Lewi asɔfodie so enti na wɔde Mmara no maa Israelfoɔ.
hypothesis: Nnamlewi asɔfodie so ho ti, ɛna wɔde mmerɛ no mmaa akyire afɔwɔ no.

reference: Nanso, Yesu deɛ, ɔwɔ hɔ daa na nʼasɔfodwuma no nso, obi ntoa so mma no.
